title: SynEHR: Joint Modeling Inter-visit Temporal Evolution and Intra-visit Clinical Structure for Longitudinal EHR Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2608.21673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) document patients' sequences of clinical visits over time, preserving the temporal evolution of disease progression and care delivery. However, real longitudinal EHRs are difficult to access because they contain large amounts of fine-grained, patient-specific information. Synthetic EHR generation therefore provides a valuable approach for preserving the statistical patterns and clinical structure of patient visit trajectories, enabling broader modeling and analysis when real records are limited. Although recent generative models have made progress in producing future visit sequences, they remain limited in explicitly integrating inter-visit irregular temporal evolution and intra-visit clinical event structures in EHRs, leading to clinically inconsistent and temporally unrealistic visit sequences. In this work, we propose SynEHR, a lightweight adaptive LLM-based framework for longitudinal EH

translated_title: SynEHR：联合建模就诊间时间演化与就诊内临床结构以生成纵向电子健康记录
translated_abstract: 纵向电子健康记录（EHRs）记录了患者随时间的临床就诊序列，保留了疾病进展和医疗服务的时序演化。然而，真实的纵向EHRs难以获取，因为它们包含大量细粒度的、患者特定信息。因此，合成EHR生成为保留患者就诊轨迹的统计模式和临床结构提供了一种有价值的方法，在真实记录有限时能够支持更广泛的建模和分析。尽管最近的生成模型在生成未来就诊序列方面取得了进展，但它们仍局限于显式整合EHR中就诊间的不规则时间演化和就诊内的临床事件结构，导致生成的就诊序列在临床上不一致且时间上不真实。在本工作中，我们提出了SynEHR，一个轻量级、基于自适应LLM的框架，用于纵向EHR生成。
tldr: 本文提出了SynEHR框架，通过自适应大语言模型联合建模就诊间时间演化与就诊内临床结构，生成临床一致且时间真实的纵向电子健康记录。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SynEHR, a lightweight adaptive LLM-based framework that jointly models inter-visit temporal evolution and intra-visit clinical structure to generate clinically consistent and temporally realistic longitudinal EHRs.
